purpose: Trace M4 domain evidence without equating inventory, text reading, author reports and generated-video validation.

reading_policy.full_text_read: Complete semantic text reading; full ranges recorded. Parent-reported reading is attributed to parent.
reading_policy.relevant_sections_read: Only the recorded 1-based inclusive line ranges were semantically read; retrieving a full tool result is not full reading.
reading_policy.inventoried_only: Path, size, line count and hashes only; no claim of semantic review.
reading_policy.read_scope: Alias of semantic_review for explicit source-scope reporting.
reading_policy.line_count: len(UTF-8 text.splitlines()); ranges are 1-based and inclusive.
reading_policy.prior_commit_reads: Previously read content was matched by Git blob to the indexed commit; no unverified carry-forward.
reading_policy.derivatives: Translations and vocabulary expansions are inventory entries, not independent experimental evidence.
reading_policy.media: Original image, video and audio media were not observed; timing and quality claims remain unverified.

evidence_levels.F: Source-text fact or specified design; not demonstrated generation success.
evidence_levels.A: Author-reported result; not independently measured or observed in this release.
evidence_levels.D: M4 design inference or illustrative example; label explicitly.
evidence_levels.I: Implementation or text-contract validation; not H3 inference.
evidence_levels.U: Original-media, physical-execution and final-output quality remain unverified.

cases.review_scope: See exact file-level read_scope and read_line_ranges; no media observed
